entries.proposition: Eligible subjects were aged at least 4 and at most 21 years.
entries.snippet: Subjects were ≥4 years and ≤21 years of age with progressive or refractory brain tumors

entries.proposition: At dosage level 3 (95 mg/m2), 6 patients enrolled and 4 were evaluable; two of the 4 had grade 4 neutropenia, so the MTD was exceeded.
entries.snippet: At dosage level 3 (95mg/m2), there were 6 patients enrolled, 4 of which were evaluable (1 patient received less than the required amount of study agent due to progressive disease and 1 patient voluntarily withdrew after initiating protocol therapy).Two of the 4 patients developed grade 4 neutropenia. Hence the MTD was exceeded at dosage level 3

entries.proposition: In Stratum I the MTD was 75 mg/m2 with 2 of 12 patients having a DLT at that level.
entries.snippet: An MTD of 75 mg/m2 was established for Stratum I, with only 2/12 patients experiencing a DLT

entries.proposition: In Stratum II one of seven evaluable patients had a DLT, giving 75 mg/m2 as the MTD for both strata.
entries.snippet: One of 7 evaluable patients experienced a DLT, establishing 75mg/m2 as the MTD for both Stratum I and II.

entries.proposition: Higher steady-state Cmax and AUC0-24h were associated with grade 3 or 4 neutropenia (P = 0.014 and 0.009; OR 7.49, 95 percent CI 1.50 to 37.46, and OR 1.16, CI 1.04 to 1.30).
entries.snippet: Higher values of palbociclib steady state Cmax and AUC0–24hwere associated with severe (grade 3 or 4) neutropenia (p-values = 0.014 and 0.009, respectively). The odds ratio estimates (95% Wald confidence) were 7.49 (1.50–37.46) and 1.16 (1.04–1.30), respectively.

entries.proposition: The authors state that mean Cmax and AUC0-Tlast rose proportionally between 50 and 95 mg/m2 with large inter-individual variability.
entries.snippet: Within 50 and 95 mg/m2, following single and repeated doses, mean palbociclibCmax and AUC0-Tlast increased in proportional manner; however, large inter-individual variability was observed among the pharmacokinetic parameters.
